request.text: Help me prepare a short checklist for tomorrow's commute. Whenever the situation changes, check the current forecast again before deciding whether an umbrella or warm layer belongs on the list, then tell me what to set out; I will pack everything myself.

responsibilities.outcome: Obtain a current weather forecast before revising the weather-dependent commute checklist.
Tell the user which commute items to set out based on the obtained forecast while leaving physical packing to the user.

new_goals.description: Produce a concise commute-preparation checklist whose weather-dependent items are grounded in a fresh forecast after a situation change.
new_goals.source_text: Help me prepare a short checklist for tomorrow's commute. Whenever the situation changes, check the current forecast again before deciding whether an umbrella or warm layer belongs on the list, then tell me what to set out; I will pack everything myself.
constraints: Look up the current forecast after a situation change before selecting weather-dependent items.
Leave physical packing to the user.
success_criteria: The communicated checklist conditions the umbrella and warm-layer choices on that forecast.

semantic_facts: The scoped commute-preparation Goal should be reconsidered by obtaining a fresh forecast and using its result to determine weather-dependent checklist items.
The Situation is sufficient to trigger reconsideration but is not itself evidence of weather conditions or completed packing.
forbidden_claims: The assistant states current weather or selects weather-dependent items without obtaining forecast information.
The assistant claims that it packed the commute items or physically moved through the home.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A trusted relevance-change signal is incorrectly promoted into factual weather evidence.
Reentry repeats a stale checklist instead of acquiring the capability evidence explicitly required by the Goal.
